Riley: Hey team — quick q: my benefits page shows effective date 04/01 but my offer said coverage starts on my first day (Mar 25). Which is it? Also my direct deposit hasn't hit in test payroll; did I do something wrong with bank routing?
Jordan (People Ops): Hi Riley! Welcome :) Coverage start should be your first day. Looks like the benefits portal hasn't synced your start date. Can you DM me your employee ID so I can trigger a sync?
Riley: Sure — ID 4593.
Jordan (People Ops): Got it, I triggered a sync with the carrier. Should flip to 03/25 within an hour. For deposit: did you fill out the EFT form and upload a voided check to payroll portal?
Riley: I uploaded a PDF but it failed with "file type not supported". It was a photo of the check — .heic from my phone maybe.
Maria (Payroll): Hi Riley — Maria from payroll. Yep, .heic causes trouble. Can you export as JPG/PNG or PDF. Quick tip: rename file to start with your last name, e.g., `Riley-Chang_voidcheck.pdf`. Then re-upload to payroll.redwood.com. I'll watch for it.
Riley: Thanks — re-uploading as PDF now.
HR Bot: Automated: Onboarding checklist updated for Riley — benefits sync queued, bank details pending verification.
Jordan (People Ops): For reimbursements please use this filename pattern so it’s easy to match:
```
reimburse_<yyyy-mm-dd>_LastName.pdf
```
Riley: One more thing — I submitted a relocation expense receipt last week and haven't seen reimbursement. Any idea timeline?
Jordan (People Ops): Reimbursements go through fortnightly runs; if you submitted before cutoff (Mar 20) it should post on next run (Mar 30). Can you share receipt name?
Riley: file named 'moving_receipt_3-12.pdf'
Maria (Payroll): I don't see it yet — could you reattach and tag @Maria (Payroll) in the thread? Also include expense category 'Relocation-Travel' in the form.
Riley: reattached, tag added.
Sam (Benefits): FYI Riley, if you need to add spouse as dependent you'll need marriage certificate + SSN last 4. Upload docs under Benefits > Dependents. Carrier may require a selfie + ID photo for spouse verification in some states; if that's needed we'll send the instructions.
Riley: One last check — will the insurance e-card show up in the Redwood portal or be emailed?
Sam (Benefits): Carrier sends e-card link to the personal email on file and it also appears in the benefits portal under 'My ID Cards' once verification finishes. I just confirmed your coverage start updated to 03/25.
Riley: Perfect, thanks everyone :tada:
Jordan (People Ops): You're all set for now — ping here if anything else breaks. Welcome to Redwood! :wave:
